evidence: Diethylcyclopentadienyl ruthenium (Ru/H20849EtCp/H208502) vapor was generated in a bubbler at 80°C and carried by Ar at a flow rate of 100 sccm. For the PEALD, radio frequency plasma of NH3 was used as a reactant at a plasma power of 100 W. The flow rates of NH3 during pulsing and Ar during purging were both 150 sccm. For the thermal ALD, the reactant was O2 at a flow rate of 20 sccm.
